title: afalcatus-cp-regulatory: reproducible in silico identification of chloroplast regulatory elements in microalgal plastomes
description: Knowledge-based, statistically controlled workflow (v3) to identify promoter, Shine-Dalgarno-like, start-region and 3' -end regulatory signals in chloroplast genomes, calibrated against experimentally validated Chlamydomonas reinhardtii elements and applied to Ankistrodesmus falcatus UNAP_012026 (GenBank QB176266.1) and 40 green-algal plastomes. Includes the run script, conda environment, regression tests, input data and manuscript tools. Code accompanying the article submitted to Plant Molecular Biology.
